description: Sprint east holding W and die (/kill) still holding it: the death screen opens and lets go of the keys, the server's motion packet stops the body, and 20 ticks later the client takes the player out of the level (no more ticks or movement packets); Respawn once its buttons work, back at the spawn point (4 -60 4), and walk south. Then jump, die in the air (the body falls to the ground), respawn the same way and walk.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
